dish: modern-Vietnamese tasting menu (Burrata & Dalat tomato, Cà Mau mud-crab miến xào)
address: Thảo Điền, Thủ Đức City, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
w: Chef Cường Nguyễn (ex-sous chef of MICHELIN-starred Anan Saigon) reinvents Vietnamese comfort food in a stately Thảo Điền villa; a MICHELIN Selected restaurant (2023 inaugural list, in the 2026 Guide) with a coveted eight-seat Chef's Table.

address: Nguyễn Văn Linh, Tân Phong Ward, District 7 (Phú Mỹ Hưng), Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
w: A decade-old Korean cold-noodle specialist run by owner Joo Won-mi in D7's Koreatown, its back looking onto the Phú Mỹ Hưng enclave; Saigoneer calls it the city's best naengmyeon.

address: 38 Nguyễn Ư Dĩ, Thảo Điền, Thủ Đức City, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
w: Saigon's benchmark riverside restaurant-bar (since 2008) on a near-rural stretch of the Saigon River; named by The Guardian among the world's best bars, and Rusty Compass's pick for the city's best riverside meal.

dish: European dishes with a Japanese twist & natural/house-brewed wine pairings
address: Thảo Điền, Thủ Đức City, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
w: Thảo Điền wine bar helmed by Osaka-born sommelier Yu Yamamoto, the first winner of the MICHELIN Guide Vietnam Sommelier Award (2023); farm-sourced European-Japanese plates against an outstanding wine list.

address: 19 Đường Số 2, Thảo Điền, Thủ Đức City, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
w: The Thảo Điền outpost of XLIII (formerly 43 Factory Coffee Roaster), a transparency-first specialty roaster since 2018, set in a courtyard house of traditional Vietnamese architecture; ultra-light roasts and precise pour-overs.

dish: Provençal haute cuisine (lobster medallions with truffle, Grand Marnier soufflé)
address: Ngô Quang Huy, Thảo Điền, Thủ Đức City, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
w: Chef-owner Thierry Mounon's elegant colonial villa off Thảo Điền serving classic French gastronomy from the southwest; a MICHELIN Selected restaurant (2023 & 2024) with a deep French wine list.

dish: upscale izakaya fusion (caviar, foie gras & lobster small plates)
address: Thảo Điền, Thủ Đức City, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
w: An intimate ~18-seat Thảo Điền izakaya that layers Japanese pub culture with occidental luxe ingredients at friendly prices; a contemporary take praised by Vietcetera and Saigoneer.

dish: clean Scandinavian comfort food in a garden villa
address: 6/1/2 Nguyễn Ư Dĩ, Thảo Điền, Thủ Đức City, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
w: Danish couple Camilla Bailey and Casper Gustafsen's converted villa ('mad' means food in Danish) under shady tropical trees; clean Scandinavian flavours, weekend acoustic sets and an award for the city's best neighbourhood hangout.

dish: all-day Mediterranean-Asian breakfast & brunch in a hidden courtyard
address: Thảo Điền, Thủ Đức City, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
w: Thảo Điền's oldest surviving expat cafe (since 2004), a rustic hidden-courtyard mainstay from the owners of The Deck; Mediterranean cooking with Asian flavours, breakfast through late evening.

dish: home-style Korean comfort food & a seasonal banchan spread
address: District 7 (Phú Mỹ Hưng), Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
w: A homey D7 Koreatown kitchen focused on wholesome, health-minded cooking with one of Saigon's most generous, frequently-changing banchan spreads; a Saigoneer Hẻm Gems feature.

address: District 7 (Phú Mỹ Hưng), Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
w: A small D7 Thai-noodle spot run by Quan, who cooked in Thai restaurants during a decade in Australia; punchy, takeout-friendly bowls spotlighted by Saigoneer's Hẻm Gems.

address: Thảo Điền, Thủ Đức City, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
w: The Thảo Điền branch of one of Saigon's most-loved French patisseries, in a three-floor glass building (bakery-cafe below, bistro above); minimalist design, organic local fruit and biodegradable cassava-starch packaging.
